# The Japan Times

> English-language news and analysis covering Japan, Asia, world affairs, business, culture, sports and life.

The Japan Times is a long-running English-language publication based in Japan. Its site includes breaking news, opinion, explainers, feature reporting, newsletters, podcasts and topic pages spanning domestic politics, the economy, society, international relations, arts, travel and sports.

## Top News
- [Latest News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/): Main news hub for Japan, Asia-Pacific and world coverage.
- [Japan News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/japan/): National reporting on politics, society, crime, policy and current events.
- [Asia-Pacific News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/asia-pacific/): Regional coverage from East Asia, Southeast Asia and the wider Pacific.
- [World News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/world/): International news, diplomacy, conflict and global developments.
- [Breaking News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/breaking-news/): Fast-moving updates on major events and urgent developments.

## Japan Coverage
- [Politics](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/politics-diplomacy/): Reporting on Japanese politics, elections, parties, legislation and diplomacy.
- [National](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/national/): Domestic stories on public policy, disasters, crime, education and social issues.
- [Business](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/): Coverage of companies, markets, trade, labor and Japan’s economy.
- [Features](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/features/): In-depth reporting, profiles and long-form journalism on major issues.
- [Explanatory Reporting](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/explanatory-reporting/): Context-driven articles explaining complex Japanese and global topics.

## Opinion and Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/opinion/): Editorials, columns and expert commentary on Japan and world affairs.
- [Editorials](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/opinion/editorials/): Institutional viewpoints on policy, politics and public issues.
- [Commentary](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/opinion/commentary/): Analysis and perspective from contributors and specialists.
- [Reader Mail](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/opinion/reader-mail/): Letters from readers responding to current events and coverage.
- [Deep Dive](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/deepdive/): Analytical and enterprise reporting on important trends and debates.

## Business and Economy
- [Business News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/): Reporting on finance, industry, trade and corporate developments.
- [Economy](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/economy-business/): Coverage of macroeconomic trends, inflation, wages and fiscal policy.
- [Corporate News](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/corporate-business/): Company strategy, earnings, mergers and executive developments.
- [Tech](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/tech/): Technology industry news, innovation and digital policy coverage.
- [ESG and Sustainability](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/business/esg-business/): Reporting on sustainability, governance and environmental business issues.

## Life and Culture
- [Life](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/): Coverage of society, relationships, health, language and everyday life in Japan.
- [Culture](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/culture/): Arts, entertainment, literature, film, music and cultural commentary.
- [Food](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/food/): Articles on restaurants, cuisine, recipes and food culture in Japan.
- [Travel](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/travel/): Destination features, itineraries and travel reporting from across Japan.
- [Style](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/style/): Fashion, design and lifestyle trend coverage.
- [Language](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/life/language/): Writing and language-focused columns for English readers in Japan.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/): Comprehensive sports coverage from Japan and international competitions.
- [Baseball](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/baseball/): NPB, MLB and player-focused baseball reporting and analysis.
- [Soccer](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/soccer/): J.League, national team and international football coverage.
- [Sumo](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/sumo/): Tournament reports, rankings, wrestler profiles and expert commentary.
- [Olympics](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/olympics/): Coverage of Olympic events, athletes and related developments.
- [More Sports](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sports/more-sports/): Basketball, rugby, tennis and other sporting news.

## Podcasts and Multimedia
- [Podcasts](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/podcast/): Audio programs covering news, culture, business and Japan-focused topics.
- [Deep Dive Podcast](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/podcast/deep-dive/): Interview and analysis podcast exploring major stories in depth.
- [Japan Explained](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/podcast/japan-explained/): Podcast unpacking Japanese politics, society and current affairs.
- [Videos](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/video/): Video journalism, interviews and visual reporting.
- [Photo Essays](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/multimedia/): Visual storytelling and image-led features.

## Special Products
- [Bilingual Series](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/bilingual/): English-learning and bilingual reading content based on current topics.
- [Alpha](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/alpha/): English-learning news product for students and language learners.
- [Study in Japan](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/study-in-japan/): Education-focused content for international students considering Japan.
- [Sustainable Japan](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/sustainable-japan/): Special coverage on sustainability, ESG and social impact.
- [Real Estate](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/real-estate/): Property market news, housing trends and real estate features.

## Newsletters and Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/newsletters/): Email newsletters featuring curated reporting and topic-specific updates.
- [Subscribe](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/subscribe/): Subscription plans and digital access information.
- [My Account](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/account/): Account management for subscribers and registered users.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/subscribe/gift/): Options for purchasing subscriptions for other readers.

## About and Contact
- [About Us](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/about-us/): Background on the publication, mission and newsroom information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/contact-us/): Contact details for editorial, business and customer support inquiries.
- [Staff List](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/about-us/staff-list/): Directory of editors, reporters and contributors.
- [Work With Us](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/about-us/work-with-us/): Careers and employment information at The Japan Times.
- [Press Releases](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/about-us/press-releases/): Corporate announcements and official company updates.
